title: 🎟️ One Piece Card Game Fan Festa 2026 — registration open (closes Oct 25)
body: Bandai opened registration for ONE PIECE Card Game Fan Festa 2026 (Aichi Sky Expo, Japan, 13 Dec). Entry runs 16–25 Oct, with a limited ¥8,800 merch set — playmat, storage box, 70 sleeves and 10 DON!! cards — for successful applicants.

announcement.news: Bandai has opened registration for the ONE PIECE Card Game Fan Festa 2026, held 13 December 2026 at Aichi Sky Expo in Japan. Entry runs 16–25 October 2026, with lottery results announced on 30 October and 4 November. Winners can buy a limited event merchandise set (¥8,800) that includes a playmat, a storage box, 70 sleeves and 10 DON!! cards — one set per successful applicant, collected at the venue.
announcement.analysis: This is a lottery-entry event: you register for a chance to attend and buy, not first-come. The merch set is capped at one per winner and only collectible on-site in Japan, so it's really aimed at attendees. Event-exclusive merchandise like this sometimes resurfaces on the secondary market at a premium afterward, though demand for this set isn't established yet.
announcement.value: For collectors who'll be in Japan on 13 December, the ¥8,800 set (playmat, storage box, 70 sleeves, 10 DON!! cards) is the draw — event exclusives can hold their value once the show is over. For everyone else, only register if you can actually attend and collect on-site, since pickup is at the venue in Japan.
announcement.deadline: Registration: 16–25 October 2026 (Japan time; exact closing hour not confirmed). Lottery results: 30 Oct & 4 Nov. Event: 13 December 2026.
announcement.risk: Japan-only physical attendance, lottery allocation (a slot isn't guaranteed), on-site collection only, and unproven resale demand. Don't register purely to resell participation.

title: 🃏 New starter decks ST-37 (Alabasta) & ST-38 (Baroque Works) — out Dec 19
body: Bandai detailed two Japanese starter decks for 19 Dec 2026 (¥1,320 each): ST-37 'Desert Princess and the Pirates' (red/blue, Straw Hats + Vivi) and ST-38 'Baroque Works' (blue/black, Crocodile). Each has a 51-card deck, 10 DON!!, a bonus pack and a play sheet.

announcement.news: Bandai has revealed two new Japanese starter decks releasing 19 December 2026 at ¥1,320 each. ST-37 'Desert Princess and the Pirates' is a red/blue deck built around the Straw Hats and Alabasta (Vivi), while ST-38 'Baroque Works' is a blue/black deck led by Crocodile and the Baroque Works crew. Each set contains a 51-card constructed deck, 10 DON!! cards, a bonus pack and a play sheet.
announcement.analysis: Starter decks are the cheapest, most beginner-friendly way into the game, and splitting the desert (Alabasta) arc into two opposing decks — the Straw Hats/Vivi vs. Crocodile's Baroque Works — is a neat hook for new players and arc fans alike. Any reprinted staples inside can also ease prices on those singles.
announcement.value: For players, these are a low-cost way to grab a ready-to-play deck plus any reprinted staples cheaply; for collectors, the Alabasta (Vivi, Straw Hats) and Baroque Works (Crocodile) themes are the appeal. Early launch copies are usually the cheapest, before any chase cards drive demand.
announcement.deadline: Release: 19 December 2026. Preorder windows haven't been announced yet.
announcement.risk: Full card lists aren't out, so reprints and any chase cards are still unconfirmed. Starter decks are frequently reprinted, which tends to limit sealed-product upside.

title: 🆕 EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' confirmed for late October 2026
body: EB-05 lands ~30–31 Oct 2026 — Nico Robin Leader, SP Nami & Robin, and five leader parallels. The first Heroines set is still sold out.

announcement.news: Bandai has confirmed EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' for around 30–31 October 2026 (Japan: ¥240 per 6-card pack; English: $4.99 per 12-card pack). Cards revealed so far include a Nico Robin Leader (Green/Yellow), SP versions of Nami and Robin, and leader parallels for Vivi, Shirahoshi, Hancock, Rebecca and Bonney. OP-18 'The Dominance of God' has also been announced, with an estimated ~November window.
announcement.analysis: The first Heroines set (EB-03) is still sold out, which points to strong, lasting demand for heroine cards. Japanese preorders and store lotteries usually open 3–5 weeks before release, so they could open any day now — allocation tends to matter more than the sticker price.
announcement.value: For collectors, the SP Nami and Robin and the leader parallels are the likely chase cards, and early copies at launch are usually the cheapest before hype builds. With EB-03 still sold out, sealed EB-05 could hold its value better than a typical Extra Booster.
announcement.deadline: Release around 30–31 October 2026. The preorder / lottery window has not been announced yet.
announcement.risk: The full card list isn't out yet, so the chase cards could disappoint. Extra Boosters are often reprinted, and a single-card-heavy set can mean softer demand for sealed product.
